raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19, business date 2026-01-18) delivers customer_id without zero-padding ('C180' instead of 'C00180'). Those rows fail the inner join to silver_customers and drop out of gold_region_daily: 365 distinct ids against 200 customers, and 363 missing rows, which is about batch 14's POSTED volume. The fix normalizes the ids back to the canonical 'C' + 5-digit format in silver_transactions; this assumes the unpadded ids are a pure formatting change, which no change note confirms.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(customer_id, 'C[0-9]{1,5}') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
